body:
Adds `research/decision-scoring`: when a verifier's report decides accept/reject and the outcome is seen only on acceptance, a truthful reserve payment exists iff the score's entropy minimum τ_s ≥ τ_d (unique c0 = 1+τ_d²−2τ_dτ_s). Plain Brier fails above τ_d=½; recentring fixes it at minimum rent τ³/3; exploration (IPW) is proper but costs ~1/ε payment variance. 10 stdlib tests, experiments, white paper, README and portfolio page entries.
